title: vasconcellea × heilbornii var. chrysopetala
intro: Vasconcellea × heilbornii var. chrysopetala, commonly known as the yellow flowered tree calla, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Vasconcellea × heilbornii var. chrysopetala include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates and isothiocyanates, which are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
